title: Progressive safe-apply pipeline for Optimize recommendations (gated ramp, canary controls, operator override)
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Implement a production-safe execution pipeline that automatically applies Optimize's batching and caching recommendations while enforcing multi-layered safety checks: pre-apply simulation, gated canary ramps, metric-based health gates, operator approval/override, and automatic rollback (circuit breaker). This work ties Optimize suggestion generation to a guarded apply path in the Console and the serving control plane so customers can opt-in to safe auto-apply for cost-saving suggestions without risking user-visible regressions.
acceptance_criteria: Console has a 'Safe Apply' flow that displays a diffs view for batching/caching config changes with estimated cost delta and latency risk
Operator can kick off a canary rollout (0% -> incremental buckets 5/20/50/100) with automatic evaluation windows between steps
System performs pre-apply simulation using synthetic traffic; if simulation shows >2% latency regression or <5% cost improvement, apply is blocked
During rollout, health gates monitor latency P50/P95, error-rate, token throughput, and downstream tail latency; any gate breach triggers automatic rollback to baseline
Audit log entries created for every apply attempt, approval, step progress, and rollback (linked to customer/org and user ID)
Operator can Pause/Abort/Rollforward manually at any stage from Console; manual override requires explicit justification recorded in the audit log
E2E tests exercising canary traffic split, rollback triggers, and approval UI pass in staging and pre-prod
Documentation and runbook (Confluence) published with rollback playbook and troubleshooting checklist
Migration supports both hosted and Dedicated customers by wiring the same control-plane hooks; private deployments have admin-only approval by default
